report:
WarriorCon 6 — report for Nov 15 (updated Nov 16, 8:08am ET)

SUMMARY
• 2 new tickets yesterday (148 total, 16 days to go)
• Win: 73 of 148 ticket holders (49.3%) signed up for the Warrior App (free until Dec 4)
• Watch: promote texts not delivered 26.1% to date (26,593 of 102,079 texts not delivered), above 5%. Main cause: 14,870 of 26,593 (56%) blocked by GHL's Texas SMS safeguard.

LEFT TO SEND (until Dec 2)
Promote: 6 emails · 6 texts — next: Tue Nov 17, 6:00am ET
Ticket holders: 8 emails · 8 texts — next: Tue Nov 17, 11:30am ET

TICKET HOLDERS: 148 (145 paid + 3 comps) · 2 new yesterday
Refunds: 0 to date
$31,150 total sales ($28,855 tickets + $2,295 Business Bible)
111 of 145 tickets were bought within 48 hrs of an email/text

PROMOTE (non-ticket holders)
Yesterday — Email: 22,573 sent · 27.8% open · 0.2% click
Yesterday — SMS: 3,577 sent · 82.8% delivered
To date — Email: 522,833 sent · 31.8% open · 0.3% click
To date — SMS: 102,079 sent · 73.7% delivered

POST-TICKET SEDUCTION (ticket holders)
Yesterday — Email: 128 sent · 39.8% open
Yesterday — SMS: 100 sent · 88.0% delivered
To date — Email: 1,098 sent · 45.3% open
To date — SMS: 684 sent · 87.7% delivered

UPSELLS
Warrior App (Power Plan): 73 · 49.3% of ticket holders
Business Bible: 21 sales · $2,295 · bought by 20 of 145 paid buyers (13.8%)
(Texts have no open rate.)
